findings.finding: Harm: (a) wayfinder sentence loses 'hold in mind' and the stick charts being memorized before a voyage and not taken to sea ('its charts ashore' is vague), adds 'alone', drops Marshallese, and parts from the paragraph; the file's own line 474 already says 'memorizes the stick charts before a voyage and sails without them', so reuse it; (b) 'its going on a between, two files' workings at its two ends' is unclear and gives a nothing 'ends' (old: carry a membrane between two files' workings); (c) 'the value a bi-coupling's working has' loses 'what ... has', leaving 'its rest' with nothing to be the rest of; (d) 'verify-first' (verify dissolved, standard family) and 'gathering complete' (complete dissolved to completing) are dead words carried from old; (e) 'each value it finds' narrows 'what it finds'.
findings.proposed_new: Gathering goes backward over a whole standing body of work and seats each thing it finds forward to living files, logging nothing: no history, no journey, no roster of things a self does. A record a field publishes is incoming, and interpreting is receiving it. A gathering receives a field's own convergences, still-possibling to a naming, as they stand, and illumination across instances observes each instance through its others. A gathering sets recurrences aside to watch, apart from each claim. Seating forward is observing-first: an aim a self is observing finds its seat standing already or is-not finding it, and a sweep returning things already seating is a gathering completing at that place. And an observing working to its edge with one file goes to its dual's opening, its going on a between of two files' workings. A two-ledgers diagnostic is a gathering instrument, and living-archive laws are gathering's condition: a living archive stays open by a gatherer's own open frontier. And a working gathers with its own close: each thing a bi-coupling's working has, ungathering, a gathering sweeps backward ahead of the working dissolving, seating its value forward to living files and dissolving its rest, logging nothing; a sweep returning only things already seating is that working's gathering completing. A Pacific wayfinder is going on with a voyage's speed, heading and time through days of waking with short sleeps, and a Marshallese voyager memorizes the stick charts before a voyage and sails without them.

findings.finding: Harm: 'outward check' turns 'external check' into a momentary's direction (outward) and loses its standing apart from the gathering; 'measure ... against' uses dissolved standard-family words; 'by their own form' drops the old 'a reason of their form' claim of cause.
findings.proposed_new: The improving report is a gathering form's first standing instance: a work-side of a gathering whose subject-side is living files, dissolving as each improving seats and reaching zero, each aim going onward routing to its file ahead of the report dissolving. And the registry is its second: a gathering set two conditions define, inclusion criteria it states and uniform per-entry structure, a form fields already have under a formal name with an assessment apparatus a field publishes, of four domains, protocol and design, standardization, validity of sampling procedure, and validity of data collection, whose item is unique identifiers. Both conditions go together for a reason of their own form: uniform fields with no statement of inclusion give a table of coverage unknown to each self, and a statement of inclusion with no uniform fields gives a list of entries beyond comparing, and together they give comparability across sites. A four-domain apparatus stands as a check apart from each gathering, one each self can set each gathering beside.

findings.finding: Harm: loses 'closes a schema once, with one place' and 'nothing else has to close' (one-closure value), and 'same at all momentaries at once' is a stronger claim than 'closes once' (kept here only because the brief asks for the registry phrase; the file's 5.6 already uses 'a form still'); 'Against them' is a dissolved opposing 'against'; 'each two things' is unclear, say 'each pair of things'; the 7.3 heading still says 'one closure' while the text now says 'form still'.
findings.proposed_new: A gathering stands open four ways: subject open, intake open, properties and checks open, and each line open with an address. Among them one form is still, its properties, uniform elements making two entries comparable: a gathering closes a schema once, with one place, and that schema is a form still, same at all momentaries at once, and each other line lives open. This is a general form of each gathering: openness is its living, and one form still lets each pair of things in a gathering bi-couple.

findings.finding: Harm: 'takes up' is dissolved (take family, carried from old); 'incomplete' is a dissolved 'complete' (say 'a record of work still completing'). Otherwise value and meaning kept.
findings.proposed_new: An entry has two kinds of line: lines standing about its subject, and lines standing about a self's work on it. Splitting them, the first is the thing a later observing has and the second the thing a later working goes on with: a record of work still completing leaves an observing open, and a defect of its subject-lines blocks one. Improving reports are a work-side, living files a subject-side, and this split is a form-condition of gathering.

findings.finding: Harm: (a) machine item inverts the brief: 'a competent response alone being an observing of the response' says the opposite of 'is not an observing of the machine's own changing'; it also drops 'artificial-intelligence', 'repeated exchange', and 'imposed' (new 'count from outward' is a dissolved count and a direction, not an imposing); (b) 'viruses within cells' is missing from the list; (c) 'in a laboratory' dropped from the made-from-no-prior-living item; (d) 'a tardigrade drying out' is a process, not 'a dried tardigrade' (dormant); (e) 'one of its two leaving' is a leaving, not a removing (brief 'removed'; file 2.2/3.3 use 'removing'); (f) 'each still-possibling to look for' loses 'a possible observing question, not a finding'; (g) 'a virus outside a cell' is a dissolved 'outside' as place; (h) 'taking up' dissolved; 'pair against' / heading 'against' is the dissolved opposing against; (i) 'stand beside it' has an unclear 'it' (the finding?).
findings.proposed_new:
A wide gathering of open-problem statements stands, each as one plain line, drawing from fields the exhibits gather thinly: ocean, earth, matter, anomalies, animal minds, language, deep history. Its value is as a well of statements to pair with, one at a time, going on with each thing a pair opens, its framing staying apart. One pairing from it returns an observing: each field reports its own transition as moving and reads its moving as a difficulty of locating a line, and its moving is its finding.

Places a break could show stand beside that gathering, each a question for an observing and no finding, each the method's next step or its one break: a prion copying a fold with no cell; a virus apart from a cell; a growing crystal; a dry tardigrade, nothing measurable going on; a removing of one of a living beat's two; a living form going through three with no two beneath it; a living form made from no prior living, in a laboratory; a living thing whose proteins are made throughout in the other hand; a living self with no society around or within; a machine of artificial intelligence reaching competency not prior, with no number from apart supplying its changing, a competent response or a repeated exchange alone being no observing of the machine's own changing; and, as questions to observe, frog embryos' first divisions, seeds germinating, embryos resuming from a pause, viruses in cells, fireflies coordinating, breathing with heartbeat, sleep with waking, cell division, and the lynx and hare cycles.
